prompt:
Create one realistic product-review photograph, vertical 9:16, full bleed, natural smartphone advertising photography. Product reference image 1 is the sole authority for the HELMET geometry and finish. The exact adult bicycle helmet in reference image 1: matte charcoal-black sculpted shell, broad curved projecting front visor, long angular ventilation openings and dark mesh beneath, black Y-shaped chin straps and small black buckle. Preserve the silhouette, vent layout, visor shape, dark finish and straps from the photograph. The small existing light-colored wordmark stays subtle and unchanged; never invent lettering. It is a vented BICYCLE helmet, with NO transparent face shield, no motorcycle ear covers, no LED, no camera and no extra accessory. Do not invent safety certification, impact-test performance, weight, material grade, sizing or price.
One fictional Vietnamese adult woman, about 28 years old, oval face, medium-length dark hair tied in a low ponytail, olive-green zip cycling jacket, plain black athletic trousers, short natural nails, no jewelry. Friendly understated expression, no resemblance to a named real person. Keep the exact same face, ponytail and clothing across scenes. Her mouth stays relaxed, no talking or lip-sync; male Vietnamese voice-over will be added separately.
If a second reference is supplied, use it for the exact fictional presenter's identity and clothes, not as a replacement helmet design. The helmet is the main subject, no oversized proportions, no duplicate helmet. Plausible hands, five fingers per hand, no extra limbs. Keep all important helmet parts within the central 80% of the frame. No graphic overlays, subtitles, captions, price cards or watermark.
In a bright contemporary bicycle and helmet shop with softly blurred bicycle racks and warm shelf lighting. Medium shot, presenter waist-up centered slightly to the right. She holds the complete helmet at chest height toward camera, one palm beneath it and the other hand lightly at the side, in the same front-left three-quarter angle as the product photo. All straps hang freely and are visible. Helmet dominates the lower-middle foreground, presenter face visible above it. No display stand or duplicate helmets in the foreground.
